Our mission:
To radically improve Black maternal health outcomes through innovation, intelligence, and compassion.

A world where no mother is lost due to bias, delay, or preventable harm.

Built by a Black mothers, for Black mothers.

Whether you’d like to grow your family soon or someday in the future, our mission is to help you create a personal plan based on unbiased information and quality research.

We call this your Fyrtle LifePlan. It is a uniquely crafted blueprint based on blending your significant achievements and unique life objectives with:

- Your desire and plans for parenthood, whether soon or in the future.
- Your reproductive health and overall wellness.
- Your relationship status and hopes for the future.
- Vital preconception tests for you to consider.

The Fyrtle LifePlan was largely conceived from Dr. Katie Haigh’s groundbreaking PhD research, which demonstrated significant knowledge gaps in individuals desiring future fertility and difficult access to this valuable information from health providers.

The Fyrtle team has worked in the fertility specialty area for many years. And what we’ve most commonly been told by our patients is, “I wish I had known about _____ a long time ago.” Our “Why” is to minimize those regrets for all people, and to start a dialog so you can ask us “Why” about topics that are important to you.

Our Vision: We envision a world where reproductive health and fertility information is accessible, actionable, and compassionate for all. Let Fyrtle guide you toward your future fertility with personalized care, expert support, and a LifePlan designed just for you.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label

properties.description:
A Better Way to Reinsurance!
For decades car dealers have utilized reinsurance companies as a basic part of their F&I plans. Dealers have traditionally domiciled their reinsurance companies in foreign countries for various reasons, including lower costs and oversight. 

However, there is a new and innovative way for reinsurance companies to domicile in the continental United States while maintaining the same benefits of an offshore entity without the hassle. 

We can domicile your reinsurance company in Alabama for the same or lower costs as and offshore company, in less time, and with less paperwork. That’s right…Alabama…. has far greater advantages for your reinsurance company. 

It is not widely known that Alabama is an award winning for captive insurance companies. The advantages of domiciling your reinsurance company in Alabama are numerous. Here are a few of the following top advantages using Alabama as your reinsurance home: 

Speed – We can have your new or existing reinsurance company up and running in one day! Your company is formed when we send in the application to the State of Alabama and your provisional license is immediately granted. 

Flexibility – Your company is not simply limited to reinsurance and may include direct lender insurance policies (not reinsurance), hail damage, limited warranties, cancellation coverage, and more. 

Costs – Setting up and managing reinsurance companies in Alabama are similar or lower in costs and fees than offshore entities. 
Similar benefits of an offshore company – Each reinsurance Company is its’ own corporate entity, like an offshore company, receiving the same benefits of an offshore company with regards to distinct tax ids and tax consequences, contains their own trust or other accounts, and separate reinsurance agreements. 

U.S. company benefits – As a U.S. company there is no Hinderance on funds transfers to new accounts because of reporting requirements placed on financial institutions and other benefits.

Our platform integrates cutting-edge technology and expert medical advice to cater to individual health needs and lifestyle preferences. Whether addressing specific symptoms or proactive health management, our supportive environment is here to guide you.
We strive to create a community where women’s health is celebrated, knowledge is shared, and comprehensive tools are available to ensure every woman thrives.

Join us at Sybil Health, where your health journey is personalized, informed, and supported by experts.

Discover more about our innovative approach to women's health on our website or connect with us here for updates and support.

entity.description:
Ovy Health is a Southeast Asia-based femtech company reimagining the future of women’s healthcare—starting with fertility.

Headquartered in Singapore, we are building an integrated ecosystem that combines technology, clinical care, and personalized wellness to help women take control of their reproductive health with confidence and clarity.

Our journey began with a simple yet overlooked truth: most women don’t get proactive support until something goes wrong. Fertility care is often reactive, costly, and emotionally isolating. At Ovy Health, we believe in flipping the script—giving women the tools to plan ahead, access smarter care earlier, and receive continuous support across every stage of life.

Our flagship platform offers AI-powered pre-diagnosis, virtual patient concierge, and clinic-integrated care pathways, helping users make informed decisions about their fertility and hormonal health. Whether it’s navigating PCOS, preparing for IVF, or simply tracking their cycles, our virtual nurse offers culturally relevant, medically guided support—on app and on WhatsApp.

But we’re not stopping there. Ovy Health is expanding into fertility clinics, diagnostics, and supplements—creating a full-stack solution for women’s health. We partner with hospitals, health ministries, and wellness brands to bridge the gap between medical care and everyday health choices.

We are trusted by top clinics across Indonesia, and expanding regionally into Malaysia and Singapore. Our community spans women trying to conceive, young professionals planning ahead, and health-conscious individuals seeking hormone-friendly care.

📌 Backed by medical advisors, supported by AI
📌 Designed for women in Asia, built for global relevance
📌 Where clinical science meets compassionate care

Your plan. Your power.
Ovy Health isn’t just building a product—we’re building the future of how women are cared for.

entity.name: Matilda. Digital Endometriosis and Gynaecology Care
entity.description:
Matilda exists to improve the lives of the 190 million people with endometriosis around the world. 

People with endometriosis face long, convoluted, and invalidating journeys, but not with Matilda, a one-stop digital platform providing evidence-based and affordable education, symptom tracking, behaviour change support, group therapy, and access to specialised clinicians all from your pocket!

‘Matilda: Endometriosis care in your pocket’ was born after clinician researchers Jo Morris (Pelvic Health Physiotherapist) and Dr Kevin Wernli (Physiotherapist with a PhD in persistent pain) took out first prize at the 2022 Perth Biodesign for Digital Health course with teammates Dr Niamh Troy (Biologist and Researcher) and Maggie Woloszyn (MBA, Femtech Founder). Passion to provide better care for people with painful conditions like endometriosis, and conviction that there was a better way has led to the development of a Matilda MVP, the formation of a lived experience and clinical advisory board, and Matilda’s first customers! entity.name: U.S. Dealers Reinsurance Company, LLC
entity.description:
A Better Way to Reinsurance!
For decades car dealers have utilized reinsurance companies as a basic part of their F&I plans. Dealers have traditionally domiciled their reinsurance companies in foreign countries for various reasons, including lower costs and oversight. 

However, there is a new and innovative way for reinsurance companies to domicile in the continental United States while maintaining the same benefits of an offshore entity without the hassle. 

We can domicile your reinsurance company in Alabama for the same or lower costs as and offshore company, in less time, and with less paperwork. That’s right…Alabama…. has far greater advantages for your reinsurance company. 

It is not widely known that Alabama is an award winning for captive insurance companies. The advantages of domiciling your reinsurance company in Alabama are numerous. Here are a few of the following top advantages using Alabama as your reinsurance home: 

Speed – We can have your new or existing reinsurance company up and running in one day! Your company is formed when we send in the application to the State of Alabama and your provisional license is immediately granted. 

Flexibility – Your company is not simply limited to reinsurance and may include direct lender insurance policies (not reinsurance), hail damage, limited warranties, cancellation coverage, and more. 

Costs – Setting up and managing reinsurance companies in Alabama are similar or lower in costs and fees than offshore entities. 
Similar benefits of an offshore company – Each reinsurance Company is its’ own corporate entity, like an offshore company, receiving the same benefits of an offshore company with regards to distinct tax ids and tax consequences, contains their own trust or other accounts, and separate reinsurance agreements. 

U.S. company benefits – As a U.S. company there is no Hinderance on funds transfers to new accounts because of reporting requirements placed on financial institutions and other benefits.

Instead of relying on assumptions, Pheal learns each user’s unique hormonal profile and transforms daily logs, lab reports, and health data into personalized insights, proactive predictions, and tailored lifestyle guidance. It gives women clarity on what’s happening in their bodies, why it’s happening, and what they can do next, all in real time.

Beyond insights, Pheal creates a complete PCOD ecosystem in one place. The platform matches users with doctors who have successfully treated patients with the same symptom patterns, recommends the right medicines and supplements for their specific needs, and offers powerful AI tools such as a symptom deep dive, PCOD action plans, lab report breakdowns, meal generators, wellness metrics, and appointment prep. By combining precision AI, curated clinical care, and a seamless user experience, Pheal delivers the most comprehensive and personalized PCOD support ever brought to a single platform.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

To radically improve Black maternal health outcomes through innovation, intelligence, and compassion.

A world where no mother is lost due to bias, delay, or preventable harm.

Preggify is transforming maternal healthcare in Africa by bringing quality pregnancy care directly to women's phones-wherever they are.

The Problem
Every year, over 300,000 African women die from preventable pregnancy complications. Many women can't access proper maternal care because of distance, cost, or time. And online, they're bombarded with fake health advice that puts their lives at risk.

Preggify is a mobile app that gives pregnant women everything they need for a safe pregnancy, right on their smartphones.
24/7 access to real doctors and midwives
Tools to track your blood pressure and symptoms at home
Free, trusted health content from verified experts in our Pregnancy Academy
Live antenatal classes with other expectant parents
A supportive community of pregnant women across Africa
Preggify Champions—verified health educators fighting misinformation with facts
Our Impact So Far
Since our mobile App launched in June 2025: 
✓ Over 1,500 women across 8 countries trust us with their pregnancy journey 
✓ 6,400+ women visit our academy every month to learn 

✓ We've tracked 500+ blood pressure readings, catching problems early 
✓ We've helped 15+ women with preeclampsia; all had healthy outcomes 
✓ We're growing 30% every month

Our Mission
We believe no African woman should die from a preventable pregnancy complication. Every woman deserves safe, trusted pregnancy care, no matter where she lives or how much money she has.

Who We Are
Founded by Dr. Ifunanya Igweze (CEO), a maternal health advocate and author, and Temitayo Peter (CTO), we're combining medical expertise with technology to save lives across Africa.

Join us: www.preggify.com

Some of the projects included are tidal backflow prevention valves, raised roads, and stormwater pumps to keep our streets dry and seawalls to protect our neighborhoods. The City is actively cultivating public and private partnerships in advancing its ambitious climate resilience strategy, which also includes non-infrastructure measures such as land use planning, building codes and hurricane preparedness.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
